text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The race is over. The race King Halo and I 
have been aiming for since summer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"King Halo, having crawled her way up from 
rock bottom. Agnes Digital bore witness to 
every single chapter of that journey."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, Digital-san? Having run a big race 
alongside me, I'm sure you understand now, 
right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Just what kind of Umamusume King is.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yes... Yes...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter? I won't understand if 
you just keep crying.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I basked in it with my whole being... The 
very existence of King-san, that is.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"And they taught me. What it truly means 
to live as an Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The soul dwelling in an indomitable run! 
Pure instinct! Whether in peak condition 
or not, the determination to remain 
first-rate to the end!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Both as a fan and as an athlete, I didn't 
understand a single thing!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Today made it crystal clear to me, though. 
Self-deprecation is totally bogus! Just 
run! Save your whining for while you're 
running!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I used to only see the surface of 
Umamusume-chans, but now that I've learned 
what lies deep within—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I've come to love Umamusume even more now!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you really do love Umamusume, don't 
you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Still, just as I have my own way of 
being... that is yours. If you can take an 
interest in every single Umamusume, 
then..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Digital-san. Compete against many Uma 
Musume. Absorb everything, and then—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Become a true all-rounder. After all, you 
yourself are one of the Umamusume you love 
so dearly.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, my fellow comrade. I have 
received words of golden wisdom from 
King-san.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Compete against many Umamusume." To 
complete this, what should we do for our 
next goal?
choice_data_list:
Then shall we tour through the major 
races?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Campaigning across fronts! I see, I see! 
You mean entering tons of turf and dirt GⅠ 
races and running like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Let's do that! And next year, the hottest 
Umamusume duo I know—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Challenge Opera O-san & Doto-san!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san, did you hear? Digital-san did 
it!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, in the Ouchou Shimbun... I saw it on 
the online news. Looked like you had a 
great run in the Mile CS.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Next year she'll be in the Senior class 
too. In that case, Doto, let us give her a 
wholehearted welcome. In every single 
upcoming race.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hai-ee. But it seems they've gotten quite 
strong. ...Will we be all right? 
Especially me, I might be in trouble...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahaha! I wonder about that. For you see—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There is something she crucially lacks. 
Precisely because of her unique aptitudes.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"She is a rare all-rounder. A uniquely 
gifted runner who excels effortlessly on 
both turf and dirt."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why there are things 
that cannot be gained.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Something that cannot be obtained... What 
could it be?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That would be—a comrade who runs alongside 
you. In other words, a "Rival"!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Like Doto is to me, and you are too. 
Without an archrival, we cannot push each 
other higher.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
She is, in a sense, a traveler walking a 
pathless road. Due to her unorthodox 
nature, no one can keep up with her.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Let's see if Digital-kun can truly face 
off against us, shall we?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next year... Will Agnes Digital truly be 
able to achieve good results in each GI 
race and stand before the two of them?
